verdict.rationale: Langfuse's own docs list 'Data Retention Policies' as a product feature, but it appears only as a single line in the self-hosting license-key list and requires an Enterprise license. Nothing describes how retention is configured or how data is deleted. Self-hosting gives custody of data, but that is adjacent and not credited as retention or deletion control. Missing for 10: documentation of how retention policies are configured (scope, duration), any evidence of trace, user, or project data deletion, availability outside the Enterprise license, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Some additional Enterprise features require a license key
